incidents.name: SBR token drain
incidents.notes: The freshly deployed SBR token exposed an unguarded balance-manipulation path that let an arbitrary caller strip the SBR/WETH Uniswap V2 pair of its SBR reserve, resync the pair and sell into the drained pool for the pair's WETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: SBR 0x460B1AE257118Ed6F63Ed8489657588a326a206D created 2025-03-07T00:16:47Z by 0x0feb4a8e33bb9c0c26bad43b5e521504e1aaec47, not the attack-tx sender 0x7a6488348a7626c10e35df9ae0a2ad916a56a952; no EIP-1967 events, so the executing code was 70 minutes old. 8.495 ETH x $2,169.65 at the incident timestamp (DefiLlama) = $18,431.
